title: E-Way Bill
seoTitle: What Is an E-Way Bill? Software and Automation Guide
seoDescription: What the GST e-way bill is, when it is required, and how businesses generate it automatically from Tally, ERP or custom software through the API.
summary: An e-way bill is an electronic document generated on the government's e-way bill portal for the movement of goods above a set value under GST. Businesses that dispatch many consignments usually generate it automatically from their billing or ERP system instead of typing each one on the portal.

dataPoints.label: Required for
dataPoints.value: Movement of goods above the notified value threshold, with some exemptions; check current rules

dataPoints.label: Generated through
dataPoints.value: The e-way bill portal directly, Tally, ERP software, or the e-way bill API via a GST Suvidha Provider

dataPoints.label: Linked to
dataPoints.value: E-invoicing: for e-invoiced documents, e-way bill details can be generated alongside the IRN

dataPoints.label: Common errors
dataPoints.value: Wrong vehicle number, distance or HSN codes; expired validity on long transits

body:
## Automating e-way bills

| Step | Manual | Automated |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Invoice data | Re-typed on portal | Taken from billing system |
| Vehicle details | Entered later | Captured at dispatch screen |
| Generation | One by one | In bulk through the API |
| Extension | Remembered by staff | Alerts before expiry |

See our entry on [e-invoicing](/glossary/e-invoicing) and how [APIs](/glossary/api) connect your systems to government portals.

Rules and thresholds change; confirm current requirements with your tax adviser.

faqs.a: Yes, TallyPrime supports e-way bill generation for eligible users; custom systems use the API through an authorised provider.

faqs.q: Do we need a separate provider for the API?
faqs.a: API access is typically through a GST Suvidha Provider or similar authorised intermediary.
